mappingScope: Explicit review copy only; no automatic import conversion or language normalization.

mappingEvidence.locator: Outline text layer uses U+2019 in Thimfora_79; the Translation layer uses U+00BE in transliteration5 for the same clitic in the first word.
mappingEvidence.otherSlots: Retain source scalar and matching glyph name in the new typeface. Historical contours and metrics may differ.

alignment: Shape the 79 master once. All three layers reuse its glyph positions, em scale, baseline and page transform; do not center or normalize layer bounds independently.
